objective: Replace the four release-management free-text list searches with selection-only fuzzy suggestion controls whose choices come from real records in the current project or window scope.
users: Configuration administrators locate release windows by code or name.
Release users locate applications by application code or subsystem.
Production managers locate baseline entries and current versions by subsystem, delivery unit or artifact version.

requirements.statement: Release windows, applications, production baselines and current production versions must use one consistent selection-only fuzzy search control.
acceptance: all four pages expose the same search-select interaction
candidate labels distinguish records with secondary information
requirements.source: User limited the change to configuration management and confirmed the shared suggestion-select design on 2026-08-17.
counterexample: only one release page has suggestions
a plain el-input remains the list search control

requirements.statement: The control must show the first 20 scoped options on empty focus and perform case-insensitive substring matching across each page's declared searchable fields.
acceptance: empty focus shows at most 20 options
code, name and version fragments match
candidate ordering follows the existing data source
requirements.source: User confirmed empty-focus options and fuzzy matching on 2026-08-17.

requirements.statement: Temporary typed text must never change the main list; only selecting a real option applies a search and clearing the option restores the full list under other filters.
acceptance: unselected text is discarded on blur
nonexistent text does not empty or query the main list
selection filters to the selected record
requirements.source: User explicitly rejected free-text searching because unrecognized input should not return results.
counterexample: typing alone changes pagination or rows
clearing leaves the old query active

requirements.statement: Candidates must use complete current scope data: local loaded window, baseline and production records, and a debounced project-scoped remote application query using the existing list API.
acceptance: application suggestions can include records outside the current main-table page
other three pages avoid extra suggestion API calls
project or window changes invalidate stale selections
remote responses cannot overwrite newer queries
requirements.source: Engineering analysis of current data sources and the user-approved no-new-endpoint approach.
counterexample: application suggestions only use current page
a slow old response replaces newer suggestions

requirements.statement: Suggestion loading, no-match and failure states must be explicit without blocking or mutating the existing main list, and the control must fit the current desktop toolbars.
acceptance: loading and no-match states are distinct
remote failure is recoverable by retrying input
toolbars and dropdown text do not overlap at supported desktop sizes
frontend type-check and production build pass
requirements.source: User approved the recommended interaction and existing frontend quality constraints.
counterexample: remote failure appears as a normal empty result
candidate failure clears the main list

invariants: search selection never mutates business data
existing tenant, project and release-window scopes remain authoritative
no database migration or permission change is introduced
unrelated rokey worktree changes remain untouched
mobile remains outside the current release-management scope
constraints: approximately 300ms debounce for remote application suggestions
non_goals: global full-text search or a shared search backend
free-text submission, option creation or search history
changes to status and artifact-type filters
changes to backend sorting or data-scope semantics

selected_approach.name: release-local shared suggestion selector with mixed local and remote providers
selected_approach.reason: It keeps all four interactions consistent, reuses existing APIs and avoids a new backend abstraction when only applications need remote suggestions.

alternatives.name: independent per-page implementations
alternatives.rejected_because: selection, blur and clear behavior would be duplicated and drift

alternatives.name: unified backend suggestion endpoint
alternatives.rejected_because: the additional public API and model are disproportionate to one remote data source

inside: release-local search-select component and option model
outside: new backend APIs or database changes

components.name: ReleaseSearchSelect
components.responsibility: render and manage temporary fuzzy input, real option selection, clear, loading and no-match states

components.name: ReleaseSearchOption
components.responsibility: provide a stable value, primary label, secondary description and searchable keywords

components.name: release list pages
components.responsibility: map scoped records to options and apply only stable selected values

components.name: ReleaseManagementPrototype
components.responsibility: provide project-scoped debounced application candidate lookup without changing the main list during typing

interfaces.name: ReleaseSearchSelect props and events
interfaces.contract: stable selected value changes only on option selection or clear; temporary input is separate

interfaces.name: existing application list API
interfaces.contract: tenant and project scoped fuzzy list query with page and size

transitions: apply local exact filter or application-code query
data_flows.output: main list restricted to the selected record

error_handling.behavior: preserve the main list and selected value while showing a candidate-load failure

error_handling.condition: an older remote response arrives after a newer query
the selected record disappears after scope refresh
error_handling.behavior: clear the selection and restore the list

error_handling.condition: temporary text is blurred without selection
error_handling.behavior: discard it without emitting a selected-value change
error_handling.recovery: focus and choose a real option

security: all remote candidates retain existing authentication and tenant/project enforcement
no client-side expansion of data scope
compatibility: existing list filters and pagination remain
component is private to release management
operations: no backend redeploy required for API compatibility
revert is frontend-only and needs no data compensation

verification_strategy.signal: shared component consistently limits, filters, selects, clears and rejects free text
verification_strategy.method: component tests plus authenticated browser interaction on all four pages

verification_strategy.signal: typing does not change rows and application candidates can come from outside the current page
verification_strategy.method: request spies and page integration tests

verification_strategy.signal: scope changes, stale responses and failures recover without corrupting list state
verification_strategy.method: controlled async tests and browser checks

verification_strategy.signal: the modified frontend remains type-safe and visually stable
verification_strategy.method: vue-tsc, Vite build and desktop viewport inspection

assumptions.text: the current 200-window load is complete enough for the prototype project
assumptions.basis: the window page currently requests page 1 size 200
assumptions.falsifier: a project contains more than 200 selectable windows

assumptions.text: production baseline and current production APIs return complete current-scope records
assumptions.basis: the current pages perform local keyword filtering on the returned arrays
assumptions.falsifier: either API becomes paginated or truncated

decisions.decision: Only the four configuration-management list searches are in scope
decisions.reason: the user explicitly limited the change to configuration management

decisions.decision: Only real selected candidates may query the main list
decisions.reason: unrecognized free text should not produce a result

decisions.decision: Empty focus shows the first 20 options
decisions.reason: users can browse without typing while keeping the dropdown bounded

decisions.decision: Use a release-local shared component with a remote application provider and local providers elsewhere
decisions.reason: consistent UI with no unnecessary backend endpoint
decisions.source: User approved the recommended design on 2026-08-17.

risks.risk: remote suggestion and main-list requests race
risks.mitigation: keep separate states and ignore stale candidate responses

risks.risk: same subsystem produces many application candidates
risks.mitigation: show unique application code with subsystem and status as secondary text

risks.risk: a currently local source becomes paginated
risks.mitigation: contract tests expose truncation and the affected provider can evolve to remote mode

approval.evidence: User reviewed the landed design and explicitly requested execution on 2026-08-17.
